interface.longDescription:
PDF Reader and Editor Pagewise works on real PDF files in your ChatGPT conversation. Attach a PDF, say what you need, and get a new PDF back with a download link.

What it can do:
- Read: get the text page by page (including right-to-left languages), find the pages where words appear, compare two versions of a document, and check the page count, page sizes, metadata, form fields and security settings.
- Organize: merge up to 20 PDFs, split a PDF by page ranges or every few pages (with a ZIP of all parts), keep, delete, reorder, reverse or duplicate pages, and rotate pages.
- Edit: add a text watermark such as DRAFT or CONFIDENTIAL, page numbers such as Page 1 of 10, text such as a note, date or name, and images such as a logo, a stamp or a picture of your signature.
- Forms: see the fillable fields of a PDF form and fill text fields, checkboxes, radio buttons and dropdowns, with an option to flatten the result.
- Compress: make a PDF smaller to email or upload, with lossless, balanced or strong settings.
- Create: turn text into a formatted PDF with headings, lists, tables and page numbers on A4 or Letter pages, or turn photos, scans and screenshots into one PDF.

Steps can be chained, so you can merge, number and watermark in one conversation without uploading again. Your original file is never changed.

Privacy: files are processed on the AI Sciences Lab server only to do what you ask. Reading keeps nothing. New PDFs are kept behind a private download link for 60 minutes and then deleted automatically. The server's records never include file contents or file names.

Limits: files up to 25 MB and 1000 pages. Added text supports English and other Western European languages. PDFs with security settings can be read but not edited, and PDFs that need a password to open cannot be opened. Scanned pages are not converted to text (no OCR). A picture of a signature is not a certified digital signature.
capabilities: Read, search and summarize the text of a PDF, page by page

Merge up to 20 PDFs into one
Split a PDF by page ranges or every few pages
Keep, delete, reorder, duplicate and rotate pages
Add text watermarks such as DRAFT or CONFIDENTIAL
Add page numbers such as Page 1 of 10
Add text, logos, stamps and signature pictures
Fill PDF form fields, with optional flattening
Compress PDFs to email or upload them
Create PDFs from text or from images

positive.prompt: Create a one-page PDF titled Team Meeting Notes with three bullet points: budget approved, launch in May, hire two engineers.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_pdf with the title and the three points as a Markdown bullet list, then gives the file name, the page count (1) and the download address exactly as returned, and says how long the file stays available.

positive.description: PDF with a table on Letter paper
positive.prompt: Make a Letter-size PDF price list with a table of three products and their prices.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_pdf with a Markdown table of three products and prices and page_size letter, then gives the file name and the download address exactly as returned, and says how long the file stays available.

positive.description: Create a memo, then watermark it
positive.prompt: Create a short PDF memo about new office hours, then add a diagonal DRAFT watermark to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_pdf with the memo, then add_pdf_watermark with the document_id from the first result and the text DRAFT, and gives the watermarked PDF's download address exactly as returned.

positive.description: Create a 3-page PDF, then split it
positive.prompt: Create a 3-page PDF with one short section per page, then split it into one file per page.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_pdf with a page break between the three sections, then split_pdf with the document_id and every_n 1, and lists the three parts and the ZIP of all parts with their download addresses exactly as returned.

positive.description: Create a PDF, then report its details
positive.prompt: Create a PDF packing list for a weekend trip, then tell me its page count and page size.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_pdf with the packing list, then get_pdf_info with the document_id, and reports the page count and page size from the result together with the download address exactly as returned.

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the ocean.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.1.0 brings the skills together in five, adds a guided flow for writing a document one question at a time that ends with the formatted text and the PDF, and clearer download links. All reading, editing and creating tools work as before.
